feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 7 June 2026 6:06am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds until later.


##Wind)##

SW 4 or 5, soon increasing 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in the afternoon, decreasing W or SW 4 or 5 early tonight, then veering W or NW 3 or 4 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate building moderate or rough in the afternoon, becoming slight overnight into Monday.


##Weather)##

Mainly fair to start, then rain arriving for the afternoon, clearing to become mainly fair overnight.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

13°C

##Warnings)##

##Wind)##

##State of sea)##
